theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Build Wealth For Life's Important Milestones
body: Define your goals clearly. Align your investment approach with timelines and needs. Start early, stay consistent, and review regularly.
caption: Every major life goal deserves a dedicated strategy. Whether it's education, a home, retirement, or a wedding, systematic investing helps you work towards what matters most. Planning today shapes your tomorrow. #GoalBasedInvesting #WealthBuilding #InvestmentStrategy #LifeGoals #SmartInvesting
